spec.description:
The online-store mobile app is designed to revolutionize the shopping experience by providing users with a seamless platform to discover and purchase products effortlessly. Its core purpose is to simplify the online shopping journey, making it more intuitive, efficient, and enjoyable for users while ensuring secure transactions and real-time updates.

Key user-facing features include:
• Instant Search Filtering: Users can quickly find products that match their preferences through advanced search capabilities, allowing them to filter results based on categories, price ranges, and other relevant criteria.
• Secure Payment Options: The app integrates trusted payment solutions like Stripe and Apple Pay, providing users with a variety of secure payment methods that enhance their confidence in making purchases.
• Real-time Order Updates: Users receive timely push notifications regarding their order status, including confirmations, shipping updates, and delivery notifications, keeping them informed throughout the purchasing process.
• User-friendly Interface: The app is designed with an intuitive layout that enhances navigation, making it easy for users to browse products, read descriptions, and make purchases with minimal effort.

The business value of the online-store app lies in its ability to increase customer engagement and drive sales. By offering a streamlined shopping experience, the app encourages users to explore more products and make repeat purchases. The integration of secure payment options not only builds trust but also reduces cart abandonment rates, ultimately leading to higher conversion rates.

From a technical perspective, the app leverages robust backend systems to ensure fast and reliable performance. It utilizes APIs for payment processing and order management, ensuring that transactions are handled securely and efficiently. The app's architecture supports scalability, allowing it to accommodate a growing user base and an expanding product catalog without compromising performance.

The primary problem solved by the online-store app is the complexity and frustration often associated with online shopping. By providing a user-friendly platform with instant search capabilities, secure payment options, and real-time updates, the app addresses common pain points such as difficulty in finding products, concerns about payment security, and lack of communication regarding order status. This holistic approach to online shopping not only enhances user satisfaction but also fosters brand loyalty, making the online-store app a valuable asset in the competitive e-commerce landscape.

frameworkRecommendations.name: Next.js 15 (TypeScript + React 19)
frameworkRecommendations.description: This architecture combines a powerful React-based frontend with a robust Node.js backend, leveraging Next.js for server-side rendering and API routes.
whyReasons: Next.js provides excellent performance with automatic code splitting and server-side rendering, enhancing user experience.
PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM ensures data safety and efficient querying, making it suitable for handling complex data relationships.
The TypeScript ecosystem improves developer velocity with type safety and better tooling support.
frameworkRecommendations.bestFor: High-velocity SaaS apps with real-time requirements

frameworkRecommendations.name: React (Vite) + FastAPI (Python 3.12)
frameworkRecommendations.description: This stack separates the frontend and backend, allowing for independent scaling and development, with FastAPI providing high-performance APIs.
whyReasons: FastAPI's asynchronous capabilities ensure high concurrency and responsiveness, ideal for real-time order updates.
React with Vite offers a fast development experience with hot module replacement, enhancing developer productivity.
PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy provide a robust data management solution with strong support for complex queries and transactions.
frameworkRecommendations.bestFor: Projects requiring high scalability and rapid development cycles

frameworkRecommendations.name: Elixir (Phoenix LiveView)
frameworkRecommendations.description: This architecture leverages Elixir's concurrency model and Phoenix LiveView for real-time features, providing a seamless user experience.
whyReasons: Elixir's lightweight processes allow for handling a large number of concurrent users, making it ideal for real-time notifications.
Phoenix LiveView simplifies the development of interactive UIs without needing a separate frontend framework, reducing complexity.
PostgreSQL with Ecto ensures data integrity and safety, with powerful query capabilities for complex data interactions.
frameworkRecommendations.bestFor: Real-time applications with high concurrency needs
